notes.title: 🎄Festive Notice to all Monarchs - Rawcember has arrived!🎅
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/a9f295d3c9c88696aceffca6d51e2eb33c3cd329.gif[/img]
“Jingle, jingle…”🔔

Do you hear this lovely sound, Monarchs? 

It’s the delicate chime of the winter bells - which indicates that today is the first day of December! But, as the old legend goes, no December is merely a month in our beautiful Kingdom…

Noble Monarchs, prepare thine hearts, we invite you for this grand commencing - an event of unparalleled magnificence that shall usher in the season with merriment fit for royalty!

And the name of that event is
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/cd705518746fcb620ad3b95b806e5d8aa9da622e.png[/img]
The gates swing wide open to reveal this figure-of-speech winter wonderland! All of Raw Fury games and the team behind them come together to celebrate each other and, as the Kingdom team, we would like to share some of our fireplace stories about personal experiences with creating Kingdom✨

The most fantastic part of this month-long event is that it’s only the beginning! Expect more news, collaborations, streams, giveaways and exciting activities, some of which coming up as soon as later today🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/ce5ea4da53e687c26d03ab5aa9447c07c115f511.png[/img]

[h2][b]Join us around a cozy fireplace - it’s story time with the devs✨[/b][/h2]

[i][h3]Immerse thyself in stories that transcend time, weaving a tapestry of magic and adventure. Let the written word be a lantern guiding you through the labyrinth of imagination.[/h3][/i]

[i]“Before all character sprites were done, we would put cats in the game as placeholders! My other favorite is the randomly rotating stuff... like when the mule just decides it walks on its face.”[/i] Alan, Game Designer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/2ca753d7db6a729973166899518aab478efe4b9f.png[/img]

[i]“My fav bug is the one where you can get a duplicate dog. Two dogs. That’s a “not-a-bug-it’s-a-feature” bug, if I ever saw one.”[/i] Angelica, Experience Producer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/016cca98585be0a4d7781938ca5c464a095013f0.jpg[/img]
[i]“Three winters ago, I joined the Kingdom team and one of the first things I got to do was play Kingdom Two Crowns in co-op together with Gordon Van Dyke. He taught me a Kingdom hack I never would have figured out on my own - if you upgrade your castle several levels fast, you get your first walls and wall upgrades for free! It was a privilege to learn from the best.”[/i] Elisabeth, Producer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/912d95198d530111339faa65fb0c425a541ea18e.png[/img]
“[i]I think my favorite bug has to be in Shogun when you chop down a tree a ninja was hiding behind, he wouldn't mind and just stood there hiding in plain sight😅But being so well-trained, he pulled it off, and the Greed would walk right past him anyway. 
P.S. I'm not even sure anymore, if we fixed this or not, I think we did.[/i]” Danijel, Developer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/22ddf9751bbd4a10aa955c18ffa439cebd23cc43.png[/img]
“[i]When I joined the Kingdom team as a QA I was told to just play the game for the first couple of weeks to learn it. This liberty allowed me to figure out one of the known, but unreproducible issues. That was my first ticket in Jira and remains one of my favorite bugs to this day.😊 It was this peasant who moved like they were waterskiing. I called it "a slider".

It was challenging to reproduce and it took me about a week of playtesting to figure it out. Eventually, I exposed it!

The issue would happen when a floater would pick up a peasant and then when archers would kill the floater, the peasant would drop and remain frozen in this animation, sliding their way until they would pick up a tool and become an employed citizen.😊[/i]"Kristina, QA Manager

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/659dc112249897ed3bb5c2271fff86e537c75640.png[/img]
[i]“Now with the Christmas season coming and the snow already laying on the streets, I can’t help but imagine what it would be like to just hang out with my colleagues in Christmas jumpers, have some hot chocolate and gingerbread cookies, then altogether gather in the Gaming Room, and just play the Two Crowns co-op with one another😊”[/i] Driver, Senior Community Manager

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/6fdbd9093cbd27802cabd29761bfa7e0fb24ff8f.png[/img]

[i]“My favourite thing is playing the Christmas Event in Kingdom New Lands. No matter how many times I play it, it still makes me so happy to get to prance around on a reindeer and drop presents. I absolutely love Christmas and this never fails to get me in the festive mood.

The thing I recently discovered is that, if presents drop near the Greed, they'll take those in place of a coin and it's actually so cute seeing a little Greed holding a present.”[/i] Vicki, Community Ambassador

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/4840bd3fb2ae0cd5c6a3c4524d3f68a2f6eca282.jpg[/img] 

[h3]Share your cozy Kingdom stories with us in the comments to this post!🤗[/h3]

And don’t forget to subscribe to our social channels as Rawcember is just starting to unveil its treasures🎁

notes.title: Kingdom Two Crowns is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
The long-awaited day has finally come: [i]Kingdom Two Crowns[/i], the next full-fledged evolution of the [i]Kingdom [/i]franchise, is now available on Steam!

https://youtu.be/GnqjjY38anQ

[i]Kingdom [/i]was the first game we ever published, a simultaneously wonderful and terrifying experiment as we ventured into indie publishing for the first time, and being able to continue building upon that inaugural success years later has been a dream. As the fans and players of [i]New Lands[/i], we’re excited to show you some of the great new stuff while we’re confident you’ll feel right at home in [i]Two Crowns[/i].

[b]BEFORE I CONTINUE[/b]

Many fans of [i]Kingdom[/i] know that the joy is in the discovery and learning for one’s self. There are also those who want to know how this is different from [i]New Lands[/i]. To help with both, we’ll make the below list spoiler-marked on sensitive content.

[h1]KINGDOM TWO CROWNS FAQ[/h1]

[b]IS THIS A BRAND-NEW GAME OR AN EXPANSION TO [i]NEW LANDS?[/i][/b]
This is a full, brand-new [i]Kingdom [/i]game, built from the ground up to offer a fresh new experience that is still very much [i]Kingdom [/i]to the core. We’ve added many new features, including the Japanese inspired Shogun setting, the first of many upcoming themed settings that enhance and alter the [i]Kingdom [/i]experience both in style and strategy.

[b]IS IT STILL A ROGUELIKE/ROGUELITE?[/b]
We’ve moved away from the roguelike experience and toward a full campaign experience. Now all of the lands will be a part of your greater kingdom, with progress that will maintain over time (you just have to repair any of the erosion). 

[b]IS THERE CO-OP?[/b]
Yes! The campaign can be played either single player or local/online co-op on Steam. 

[b]IF I LOSE MY CROWN, DO I HAVE TO START OVER?[/b]
[spoiler]Unlike before, losing your crown in [i]Two Crowns[/i] is not the end. You will resume play in the new reign as your descendant who has inherited what remains of your ancestor’s kingdom. You will need to repair the erosion and recruit your followers again, but this can be done at a significantly faster rate, allowing you to pick up where you left off and explore further.[/spoiler]

[b]ARE THERE STILL UPGRADES? DO THEY STILL WORK THE SAME?[/b]
[spoiler]Yes, many of the familiar upgrades are still here, along with some new ones - but how you unlock them has changed. Now you will be required to venture to new islands to discover different upgrades and return to the previous islands in order to use them.[/spoiler]

[b]HOW DO SEASONS WORK IN TWO CROWNS? DOES WINTER END?[/b]
[spoiler]Seasons rotate regularly and no longer result in endless winter, so surviving through winter into spring is possible; you just have to build your economy to enable you to last. Seasons do not reset when you leave an island though, so be mindful of when you choose to settle a new land![/spoiler]

[b]IS THE KINGDOM STILL SECURED BY BUILDING THE BOAT AND LEAVING THE ISLAND?[/b]
Hahahaha. That’s cute. Not even close. [spoiler]You’ll have to find the technology that allows you to defeat the Greed for good, but even we’re not going to spoil that part.[/spoiler]


For more information on [i]Kingdom Two Crowns[/i], check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/701160/Kingdom_Two_Crowns/]game page[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/701160]community hub[/url], or pop on over to our [url=https://discord.gg/rawfury]Discord[/url] to chat with us, our devs, and our great community of [i]Kingdom [/i]fans!

notes.title: Kingdom Celebrates its Second Birthday!
notes.content:
Wow, it’s been two years since Kingdom released. Two. Whole. YEARS. Back when we first partnered with the talented Thomas van den Berg (AKA noio) to publish a small game about royalty stuck to horses and throwing coins at people, we knew we had found something special. A game that played just as beautifully as it looked, and we couldn’t wait to show the world.

Fast forward two years, and it looks like a lot of you agree. Over 600,000 monarchs have ventured into the realms of Kingdom and Kingdom: New Lands, recruiting loyal subjects and discovering helpful hermits across the globe. We collectively make and publish games that we love, but the immense wave of love coming from you, our biggest fans, is surreal. To show our gratitude, we’ve got some special announcements to make.

[b]We’re Adding a Sixth Island[/b]
Damn straight we are! For those of you who have been aching for more after completing island #5, your calls have been answered. But be warned: this will not be easy. Quite the opposite, really. This island is designed to test your mettle, to separate the true monarchs from the weak of spirit. If you want to win here, you’ll have to earn it.

[b]We’re Bringing Back the Halloween Event[/b]
Back by popular demand for our PC and mobile players, we’ll be having an in-game event to celebrate everybody’s favorite candy-and-costumes holiday! Jack-o-lanterns, a haunted moon, and a special new mount will be patched in for a limited time only. No tricks, only treats up in here. Well, maybe one trick

[b]Balance Updates and Performance Fixes Incoming[/b]
We’re continuing to tinker behind the scenes to improve the difficulty flow and performance on the Switch & Android versions, and will be testing these in Beta on Steam very soon. Stay tuned for more info!

Seriously though, we can’t thank all of you enough for the love and support for Kingdom over the years. As we diligently work on the next full adventure in Kingdom: Two Crowns, we can’t wait to be sharing more information about that with you soon enough.

Happy birthday, Kingdom!

notes.title: An update on Kingdom: Two Crowns
notes.content:
Back at GDC, we announced Kingdom: Two Crowns and that standalone game is still in the works! 

We wanted to give a proper update on Kingdom: Two Crowns though since it’s been a while! First off, it won’t be coming out this year like we had originally intended. WE’RE SORRY! It’s still a small team working on Kingdom: Two Crowns, and these things take some time! The vision grew larger than our original scope, to the point that this is no longer just an expansion that adds new content but rather a full-fledged new title​​​.

Speaking of new things, when we unveiled Two Crowns we didn’t give a ton of info about the game itself, but now we’re ready so here we go!
[list]
[*]New features! Well, this was a given but just to elaborate a bit we’re talking about a new win scenario, additional tech level, new citizen role, and more stuff we don’t want to spoil! And of course…
[*]Co-op! That is the biggest draw for Two Crowns for sure! Co-op will be local split screen, but it’s also hot join so a friend can jump in and out of your game at any point during the campaign.
[*]Brand new soundtrack! There will be zero tracks from any previous Kingdom game!
[*]Overhaul of visuals! The pixel art in the Kingdom series is already top notch, but we’re taking it another step up and adding new skins for the rulers.
[*]Available on lots of platforms! We announced PC and Switch, but alongside that we’ll also bring Two Crowns to Xbox One, PS4, and mobile!
[/list]
By the way, we JUST announced Kingdom: New Lands is coming to the Nintendo Switch as well. It'll be out on September 14, so it's right around the corner! http://rawfury.com/kingdom-new-lands-comes-to-nintendo-switch-on-september-14th

notes.title: Christmas update (1.2.0) is live!
notes.content:
There have been fables of an individual dressed in red running around the place, whatever could it mean? And why do our lamp posts taste like peppermint? You can't really blame us for licking the lamp post, they look too delicious not to. 

A Christmas update for Kingdom: New Lands is now live until the New Year! There are a few secrets in there, too, so happy hunting! We also took the time to tweak the game a bit, so this is an official update with patch notes below. 

Have a great holiday and a Happy New Year!

If for some reason you didn't enjoy the Christmas theme you can revert by going to the beta branch called "bah-humbug" in the game's properties tab.

[h1]Christmas Update (1.2.0) Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Differentiate archers into soldiers / hunters to make it clear when they will / won't hunt.
[*]Better feedback for the warhorse ability
[*]Farms show that they are frozen in winter
[*]Tweak wind shader for trees to render faster
[*]Better detection of controller type
[*]Fix menu on touchscreen PC's (hopefully, as I couldn't test this)
[*]Fixed animation bug for archers in towers
[*]Update compression settings for the New Lands OST tracks
[*]Banker doesn't give you back coins if you give him two or more on a day
[*]Banker can now give you coins more than once during the day
[*]Farms have a new art for the crops
[/list]


[h1]Update History[/h1]

[b]Update 1.1.0[/b]
[*]Let players choose which unlocked island to restart on after they lose the crown. 
[*]Fix bug where farmlands would only appear to the right of the farmhouse 
[*]Allow players to start a new game directly on any land from the map in the menu. 
[*]Game now discards corrupt data in preferences/unlocks file, preventing a lock-up at starting. 
[*]Fix small audio bug. 
[*]Increase how long farmers will be idle before looking for a different tool. 
[*]Fix save/load bug where flying enemy would not register that it's holding a victim. 
[*]Updated Rewired (controller support) to the latest version.


[b]Update 1.0.7 [/b]
[*]Fix a crash that happened when loading saved games with a particular farm layout. 
[*]Fix warhorse animation bug that caused it to disappear

[b]Update 1.0.5 [/b]
[*]Fix a bug that caused the menu to no longer appear after viewing the end-game map

[b]Update 1.0.4 [/b]
[*]Trolls & flyers adapt their speed based on the wave they are in, to stick together with the other enemies 
[*]The game no longer prevents a "safe state" when all currently alive enemies are far away. Previously, the game could get stuck in an "infinite blood moon" because a wave is approaching from the furthest portal at all times. 
[*]Waves (especially trolls) now better predict the duration of their trip from portal to camp. 
[*]Increase tutorial ghost speed and improve 'leading' behavior. 
[*]Fix farmhouse not being stored if saving while it is under construction 
[*]Fix visual glitch with torch light on a stag mount 
[*]Prevent farmlands from overlapping each other 
[*]Farmers are better at sticking to their assigned farm 
[*]Allow farmlands to appear on either side of farmhouse until max amount is reached 
[*]Fix bug where player could not purchase new shield after one is stolen by a troll 
[*]An empty save file will no longer crash the game during startup 
[*]A corrupted save file will now start a fresh game instead of hanging. The corrupted save is NOT deleted, so it can be salvaged or sent to developer for support 
[*]Fix a bug that caused a single boat part to disappear after saving + loading 
[*]Disallow touch controls on desktop platforms so the menu doesn't break

notes.title: Happy Anniversary! (Patch 1.0.4)
notes.content:
Dear Queens and Kings,

Today marks the one year anniversary since the launch of Kingdom! It has been a crazy, wonderful ride and even one year later we're still super excited about this game and, more so, absolutely grateful for your support. We're also still committed to improving and expanding the game 365 days after it has launched, and we will continue to do so for the foreseeable future.

I'm taking this opportunity to launch patch 1.0.4, which fixes a bunch of annoying bugs in the current version. This is slightly ahead of schedule, so let me know if it's horribly borked!

The next patch—aside from a small spooky surprise next week—will be 1.1.0. For that version I'm working on a way to let you start a new game on [i]any[/i] land immediately, probably through the map view from the menu.

Thanks for your support & enjoy!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Crash on Startup[/b] An empty save file will no longer crash the game during startup
[*] [b]Crash on Startup[/b] A corrupted save file will now start a fresh game instead of hanging. The corrupted save is NOT deleted, so it can be salvaged or sent to developer for support
[*] [b]Infinite blood moon[/b] The game no longer prevents a "safe state" when all currently alive enemies are far away. Previously, the game could get stuck in an "infinite blood moon" because a new wave is approaching from the furthest portal before the previous wave has been defeated.
[*] Trolls & flyers adapt their speed to the wave they are in, to stick together with the other enemies
[*] Waves (especially trolls) now better predict the duration of their trip from portal to camp.
[*] Increase tutorial ghost speed and improve 'leading' behavior.
[*] Fix farmhouse not being stored if saving while it is under construction
[*] Fix visual glitch with torch light on a stag mount
[*] Prevent farmlands from overlapping each other
[*] Farmers are better at sticking to their assigned farm
[*] Allow farmlands to appear on either side of farmhouse until max amount is reached
[*] Fix bug where player could not purchase new shield after one is stolen by a troll
[*] Fix a bug that caused a single boat part to disappear after saving + loading
[*] Disable touch screen controls on desktop platforms so the menu doesn't break
[/list]

Cheers

notes.title: Kingdom: New Lands Patch v1.0.2 now out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've gathered your feedback since the launch of Kingdom: New Lands and have a new patch that addresses a few things. 

[h1]Change List[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the game's engine from Unity 5.3.6f1 to 5.4.0f3
[*]Updated to the latest Steam SDK
[*]Russian Language support added
[*]Fixed issue with Hermits loading incorrectly
[*]Fixed several issues with knights and the boat
[*]Optimized Audio Pooling (with rate limiter)
[*]Tweaked worker's behavior when completing jobs far from the outer walls.
[/list]
Hopefully this creates a smoother experience for you all! Let us know how you like it.

notes.title: Kingdom: New Lands out August 9!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=YCkhhwvKz2s

Kingdom: New Lands is coming to PC in less than a week! We can hardly believe it ourselves. We've had some fun getting the game prepped for release and now the release of Kingdom: New Lands is fast approaching like a monarch on a speeding horse galloping away from a dozen greedy creatures intent on taking their crown (a.k.a. just another day at the office).

WE HAVE A NEW TRAILER FOR NEW LANDS. It's the first trailer and the last trailer. The alpha and omega. The one trailer to rule them all. Did you see all those new mounts? And new characters? And a new statue? It ain't called New Lands for nothin'!

Kingdom: New Lands is an expansion for Kingdom, but it's also like a sort of gold edition of the game. It will be the definitive version going forward and it will be the only version we sell from here on out. On PC, though, we'll have it set up so that you can play the original Kingdom game when purchasing New Lands if you wish. When Kingdom: New Lands launches on PC and Xbox One, it'll be priced at $14.99 / €14.99 / £11.99. 

If you already own Kingdom (Windows/Mac/Linux only) through Steam, GOG, and other official partner sites, then you can sail away to the New Lands for zero money when it launches August 9th whether you're using the Steam version or a DRM-free version. Caaaaa-ching. Check your library at launch! 

If you can't get enough of Kingdom: New Lands, check out the new site! kingdomnewlands.com

We're getting our castle walls fortified and our knights trained for next week's launch!
